rejected_rule.statement: A servitude or right of way acquired through notarial grant can only be abandoned if such abandonment was deliberate and intentional.
rejected_rule.supporting_quote: This principle was affirmed in Paramount Investments Ltd. V Carder (1986) 2 SLR 309. It was further held in this case that under our law, a mere non possession of a right does not amount to losing the said right or servitude. Therefore, the burden is on the Respondents to prove that the Substituted Appellant or her predecessor deliberately and intentionally abandoned the right of way.
